stream.why: In streaming mode the openai client raises APIConnectionError when the SSE stream is cut off and does not retry; the run ends before the result is re-sent. Non-streaming requests are retried and PASS.

mcp-protocol-error.why: Documented SDK default: default_tool_error_function returns a fixed message without the exception text; configurable with failure_error_function.

mixed-content.why: Chat Completions tool results cannot carry images; the SDK drops the image block.

embedded-resource.why: Not representable; the SDK serializes resource blocks as JSON inside the tool text.

resource-link.why: Not representable; the SDK serializes the block as JSON inside the tool text.

audio-content.why: Not representable; the SDK serializes the block as JSON inside the tool text.
